cover.coreProposition: Reusable approval evidence should be bound to the authorization identity under which it was produced and revalidated immediately before it becomes execution authority; recency and action identity alone cannot make a cache revocation-aware, while version equality proves only the authority dimensions encoded by that version.
cover.visualMetaphor: A reusable approval seal is held at a final gate until its current identity ring aligns with the original ring
cover.semanticObject: Two concentric authorization markers around a cached approval token, with a clear mismatch preventing passage
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a centered approval token, restrained cyan identity rings and an amber mismatch boundary
